name: make-me-unicorn
description: Launch gate for AI coding agents. Deterministic `mmu vibecheck` (no LLM, no account) blocks `git commit`/`git push` and a premature "done" while launch-blocking gaps remain: leaked secrets, unverified webhooks, Supabase tables without RLS, f-string SQL. Also ships the vibecheck skill, a /vibecheck command, and an MCP server.
